responsibility: Builds and maintains instruction dependence information for the RTL schedulers. It defines dependency objects and iterators, maps scheduler dependence status to REG_DEP_* note kinds, computes and stores forward/back/speculative dependence links, updates and resolves dependency lists as code moves, and includes logic for recognizing modifiable memory-address patterns that can break dependencies by rewriting addresses. This file is the scheduler’s dependence-analysis substrate used by Haifa, EBB, region, and selective scheduling.
